name: notebook
title_zh: 收工前把今天干的活写进 NOTEBOOK.md 的日
tagline_zh: 调试到凌晨三点，第二天完全想不起改过什么。它把这次会话的改动、踩的坑。
tagline_en: You debugged until 3am and can't recall what changed. It appends this session's edits, dead ends, and results as.
desc_en: Append a dated entry to this project's NOTEBOOK.md summarizing recent work, debugging, or experiment results. Use when the user asks to log/journal progress, update the lab notebook, or invokes /notebook — typically before a commit or at the end of a work session.
why_zh: 日志和代码住同一个仓库，跟着分支走、跟着 PR 走，不依赖任何外部服务，也不怕换电脑。
why_en: The log lives in the repo beside the code, travels with branches and PRs, needs no external service, and survives a machine.
limit_zh: 它只往项目根目录的 NOTEBOOK.md 追加，不会新建文件、不会改历史条目、不会自动提交。
limit_en: Only appends to NOTEBOOK.md at the repo root: no new files, no edits to past entries, no auto-commit. It creates the file if missing, but you define.
title_en: Logs today's work into NOTEBOOK.md before you commit
